    • ClientSocket

      @Deprecated public ClientSocket(boolean cli, String username)
      Deprecated.
      The class constructor calls the abstract parent class Client to build a new instance of the client. This constructor is used to associate a preset username to the client. This constructor is not used in the normal execution of the program and is therefore deprecated.
      Parameters:
      cli - Specifies whether the client should start in CLI-mode or GUI-mode
      username - Specifies the username associated to this client
